title: Barotrauma RPG Rules Wiki
description: An exact wiki conversion of the Barotrauma RPG Test v0.10 source document. The opening material and every source paragraph styled as a document title begin separate wiki entries; all following source text remains attached to that entry until the next source title.

source.title: Barotrauma RPG
source.conversionPolicy: Preserve source spelling, punctuation, wording, repetition, contradictions, and paragraph order without summarization or editorial normalization.
